trigger: a persistent NON-connection failure of the error-verdict chunk upsert (statement_timeout 30 s, lock_timeout 10 s, or a dark path) while a policy's check instruction is deleted or its pair mismatches
summary: Independently reported by security-guardian SG6-1, cpp-expert C-1, cpp-safety, architect A1, consistency-auditor CA6-2, unhappy-path R1/R6, sre, chaos-injector. A statement-level failure does NOT retire the connection (psql: same backend pid; PgPool::release discards only on PQstatus != OK), so all pool_size+1 = 17 attempts re-run the same doomed statement. Measured on real pg_pool.cpp + PG 18.4 (chaos): 1 chunk blocked 17.02 s at lock_timeout 1 s, 5 chunks 85.05 s, 17 attempts one backend pid. Production worst case per chunk: slow statement 17 x (30+3) s = 510-561 s (ONE chunk exceeds the 210 s grace), lock wait 170 s, dark network ~170 s; 5000 targets: 850 s lock wait, ~47 min slow statement. It runs on policy_eval_thread_ (also collect_ready and every other policy's dispatch_due: compliance evaluation and operator remediation completion starve fleet-wide) and on an HTTP worker via evaluate_now; stop() joins with a bare join (server.cpp:11913), so shutdown ends at the supervisor SIGKILL. Idempotent upserts: no corruption, but the unwritten tail keeps its old verdict for the interval and a killed process never increments the counter. Derived MEDIUM (I5(b) HIGH only if 'persistent on a serialised enforcement path' is read widely; adjudicate). EXACT FIX (sre, cpp-safety): in set_agents_error_status retry ONLY when the failure is connection-class (try_acquire_for null, PQstatus(lease.get()) != CONNECTION_OK read before the lease leaves scope, or SQLSTATE class 08/57P01-3), break on a statement error; one wall-clock budget across the WHOLE call, static constexpr 30 s next to kAcquireTimeout (= pool statement_timeout, 3 evaluator ticks of 10 s, 1/7 of the grace; bounds shutdown at about 60 s with one in-flight statement), checked before every attempt, remaining chunks counted failed; optional stop callback (not for the claimed tail the evaluator comment protects); log attempt 0 at error plus one summary line, the rest at warn (17 error lines per chunk today). Tests needed: non-connection fault not retried (retries==0, returns fast), budget honoured, kill-backend test unchanged.
classification_rationale: the fix's retry contract was never stated with a bound; its worst case exceeds the documented shutdown grace by 2x per chunk
